forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {諮|はか}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to consult; to confer with; to refer to
definitions.explanation: To formally seek advice or a decision from a council, committee, or advisory body. Used in official, organizational, and governmental contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{諮|はか}る。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{件|けん}→件：11720_ken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{審議会|しんぎかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{諮|はか}る⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This matter needs to be referred to the advisory council.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市長|しちょう}→市長：12472_shichou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{予算案|よさんあん}→予算案：09761_yosanan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{議会|ぎかい}→議会：02661_gikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{諮|はか}って⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{最終|さいしゅう}→最終：02820_saishuu⟧⟦{決定|けってい}→決定：02701_kettei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|くだ}した→下す：12329_kudasu⟧。
examples.english: The mayor made the final decision after referring the budget proposal to the assembly.

notes:
A formal verb used in bureaucratic and organizational contexts. The pattern is always ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{諮|はか}る, where ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ marks the body being consulted.

Do not confuse with other はかる verbs:
- ⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧ (to measure)
- ⟦{図|はか}る→図る：12006_hakaru⟧ (to plan; to attempt)
- ⟦{計|はか}る→計る：28292_hakaru⟧ (to calculate; to time)
- ⟦{量|はか}る→量る：28293_hakaru⟧ (to weigh)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{諮|はか}る (to consult a committee)
- {審議会|しんぎかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{諮|はか}る (to refer to an advisory council)
- ⟦{議会|ぎかい}→議会：02661_gikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{諮|はか}る (to bring before the assembly)

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{諮問|しもん}→諮問：17729_shimon⟧ (formal consultation/inquiry) is the noun form of the same concept.
